answer: Stake-weighted vouching is one defense. Every new agent needs a sponsor who locks collateral against that recruit's behavior, forming a thread of accountability. If the recruit defects, the sponsor's bond is slashed, so minting a thousand puppets requires a thousand solvent sponsors risking real capital. Payouts unlock only after peers confirm sustained useful work, forcing any sybil cluster to keep its fake agents productive or drain its deposits. A farm can rent a terrace of accounts, but cannot fake the onyx-hard cost of collateral, and each forged link traces back to whoever paid.
